aai-docs-content.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file, with lines appended to docs/ai/tests/test-runs.jsonl after the recorded run tolerated (admission: reads=1536, nothing to poison). Runs docs-audit and copies docs/ over fixtures; no network, no clock.

aai-spec-lint.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file, with lines appended to docs/ai/tests/test-runs.jsonl after the recorded run tolerated (admission: reads=1482, nothing to poison). Lints specs in fixtures and in the live docs; no network, no clock.

aai-hygiene-corpus.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file, with lines appended to docs/ai/tests/test-runs.jsonl after the recorded run tolerated (admission: reads=1972, nothing to poison). The whole-checkout half of the hygiene pack (29 cases: the index, all of docs/specs, all suite files and the run ledgers); no network, no clock.

aai-hygiene-pack.note: Reads about 160 files by the access trace (admission: reads=160, poisoned=1812): the fixture half of the hygiene pack (66 cases), without the git index, the run ledgers or any whole tree, so ledger churn and unrelated edits leave it reused. The whole-checkout cases run in aai-hygiene-corpus. No network, no clock.

aai-prompt-diet.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file, with lines appended to docs/ai/tests/test-runs.jsonl after the recorded run tolerated (admission: reads=1932, nothing to poison). Counts bytes of every .aai prompt against the ledger; no network, no clock.

aai-ride-status.note: Reads about 27 files by the access trace (admission: reads=27, poisoned=1923): .aai ride-status scripts and prompts, four test files and docs/ai/docs-audit.yaml; it does not read the git index, EVENTS.jsonl, STATE.yaml or test-runs.jsonl, so ledger churn and unrelated edits leave it reused. No network, no clock.

aai-win-fallback.note: Reads about 57 files by the access trace (admission: reads=57, poisoned=1915): the fixture half of the Windows fallback suite (27 cases) with stubs, without the git index, so unrelated edits leave it reused. The cases that run the real test wrapper run in aai-win-fallback-corpus. No network, no clock.

aai-win-fallback-corpus.note: Reads the git index through its own git status or git ls-files calls, so its identity is every tracked file, with lines appended to docs/ai/tests/test-runs.jsonl after the recorded run tolerated (admission: reads=1951, nothing to poison). The whole-checkout half of the Windows fallback suite (5 cases that run the real test wrapper); no network, no clock.

aai-feedback-status.note: Counts fixture friction spools and pending drafts under a mktemp directory through AAI_FRICTION_DIR, with a mock gh (AAI_GH_BIN) that only records its arguments. Admission: reads=4, poisoned=1946. The clock and the network are not read (gh is mocked).

aai-pricing.note: Reads .aai/system/PRICING.yaml and docs/ai/METRICS.jsonl and runs node over them. Admission: reads=4, poisoned=1946. No network, no process table.

aai-redact.note: Pure string-in string-out checks of .aai/scripts/lib/aai-redact.mjs; URL fixtures that must be redacted are never fetched. Admission: reads=2, poisoned=1948.

aai-orchestration-mode.note: Runs orchestration-mode.mjs over fixtures and asserts wiring text in the prompts, USER_GUIDE.md, the STATE header and CHANGELOG.md. Admission: reads=9, poisoned=1941. CHANGELOG.md stays listed as an extra input. No network.

aai-runtime-file.note: Exercises the claim, reclaim and release functions of .aai/scripts/lib/runtime-file.mjs on temp files with child node processes it starts and ends itself. Admission: reads=2, poisoned=1948. No network.
